title: Peter and John Help a Lame Man
summary: In Peter and John Help a Lame Man, kids slow down long enough to see the choice, pressure, or promise inside the passage. Jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need. Peter and John healed a man in Jesus' name and pointed people to Him.

read_it.prompt: Read Acts 3:1-10 and underline the part that best shows healing.

tell_it: Peter and John healed a man in Jesus' name and pointed people to Him. Peter and John saw a man who could not walk. In Jesus' name, he was healed and began praising God.
understand_it: Jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need. Peter and John Help a Lame Man gives children a way to connect the Bible event to choices they actually face.
age_5_7_explanation: Peter and John healed a man in Jesus' name and pointed people to Him.
age_8_11_explanation: Peter and John saw a man who could not walk. In Jesus' name, he was healed and began praising God. Kids can notice healing in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need.
teen_explanation: Jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need. When helping someone, this story reminds kids to give Jesus the credit instead of making themselves the hero. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Jesus' name brings hope, and God's people can notice those in need.
Peter and John Help a Lame Man shows healing through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When helping someone, this story reminds kids to give Jesus the credit instead of making themselves the hero.
life_application: When helping someone, this story reminds kids to give Jesus the credit instead of making themselves the hero.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer belongs to Peter and John Help a Lame Man?
quiz_questions.explanation: Jesus' name is the correct answer. The detail matters because it keeps the lesson tied to Acts 3:1-10, not just a general idea.

quiz_questions.question: Peter and John Help a Lame Man is mainly about healing without ignoring the actual Bible story.
quiz_questions.explanation: The theme matters because it grows out of Acts 3:1-10, not from a random moral pasted onto the end.

memory_verse.prompt: Acts 3:6 gives this lesson a short Scripture anchor to remember.

discussion_questions: What happened first in Peter and John Help a Lame Man, and what changed by the end?
Where do you see healing in Peter and John Help a Lame Man?
What is one small choice Peter and John Help a Lame Man could shape this week?

activity.title: Gate Beautiful Help
activity.instructions: Act out the moment at the gate, then say what Peter could give and what only Jesus could do.

prayer_prompt: Father, help me see what Peter and John Help a Lame Man teaches and practice healing in a real choice this week.
